entries.637e4604d69e6418: This business uses the PXB mouse, a human hepatocyte chimeric mouse whose liver is more than 70% replaced with human hepatocytes, to provide contract testing services in the preclinical stage of drug development, and sells PXB mice and fresh human hepatocytes obtained from PXB mice. It is the single segment of the group, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,565 million. The head office (Higashihiroshima City, Hiroshima Prefecture) has PXB mouse production and research and development facilities, the consolidated subsidiary PhoenixBio USA Corporation handles overseas sales of PXB mice, and CMHL Consortium LLC manages research on the usefulness of PXB mice conducted jointly with pharmaceutical companies.

entries.74b4255162f10bfa: As contract testing services related to hepatitis decline, the company intends to focus on product sales, working to expand PXB mice and PXB-cells in the safety and related field, which has a large market.
